teacher.label: Guided example · Teacher
teacher.popover: Written in advance for the Guided Tour. It doesn’t use your AI plan.
teacher.q1: What happens before Puppet Master changes my files?
teacher.a1: Before work begins, Puppet Master turns your request into a plan. You can review the important choices, correct anything that looks wrong, and decide when to begin. Your Project permissions still control what the work may change.
teacher.a1eli5: First, Puppet Master writes down what it thinks you want. You can fix the plan before anything starts. It waits for your decision to begin.
teacher.a2: A Project keeps one body of work—its files, plans, history, and Project-specific settings—together.
teacher.a2eli5: A Project is one workspace for one thing you are making. It keeps the right files and decisions together.
teacher.own: Teacher answers tour questions from its guide. Try one of these:

topics.safe: How do I undo a change?

answers.chat: Assistant Chat is where you ask for help, get explanations, and start work. Teacher explains; other guides help you build.
answers.plan: Planning Wizard turns a rough idea into outcomes and a few real decisions, so you can check the plan before any work starts.
answers.safe: Safe History saves every version of your Project. You can go back to any earlier version from the History panel.
